title: Dev pb with Dana smb and tbr
body:
in some cases, the message appear in the loop page, error wrong value about the TBR. 
I tried to identify why, and the only thing I can observe was the pump run tbr at 0.19 when aaps want to send for the same % 0.17
When this appear, if with the TBR I have a SMB, the SMB will not be send to the pump, until the value become correct for the TBR. 
The pb fixe by himself later during the rise, until the glucose value become stable, and the error show up again. 
Never have this issue on the master.
I test with Dash too, and I didn't have the pb.
